Hi Manuel, a little more information would be useful--what do you want
to do, exactly? The data frame has your x and y (df.dap and
df.BiomTotalArbol) along with fit, lwr, upr, etc., that look (by their
numerical values) as if they should be added to a model fit...are they
intervals around that polynomial fit?

Shooting a bit in the dark, it sounds like you're going to want to (i)
fit the polynomial model, (ii) plot it and the points, and then (iii)
plot any ribbons (intervals) you want around that line, for example:

fit$predict <- predict(lm(df.BiomTotalArbol ~ poly(df.dap, 3), data=fit ))
p <- ggplot(fit, aes(x=df.dap)) + geom_point(aes(y=df.BiomTotalArbol))
# data points
p <- p + geom_line(aes(y=predict), color="blue") # fitted model
p <- p + geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=predict-..., ymax=predict+...),
alpha=0.3) # interval #1
p <- p + geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=predict-..., ymax=predict+...),
alpha=0.3) # interval #2

Ben
